activation_rule: historical validation/test candidate must remain valid AND >=20 current-generation genuine FINAL replays, evaluated from a persisted pre-candidate dispersion baseline, must improve NB NLL
evidence_boundary: Applies only to score-distribution dispersion in FINAL phase. Historical evidence establishes candidacy; production activation additionally requires independent current-generation FINAL transfer.
selection_rule: Least-complexity distribution variant improving chronological validation, untouched future test, and historical exact replay transfer cohort.
transfer_caveat: The historical dispersion is a candidate until it independently transfers to the exact current predictive generation.
